items.question: What act of worship must be performed for the discus-bearing deity after completing the water recitation?
premises: The practitioner has completed bathing and recitation while standing in water.
The sequence continues with going to another place.
A great worship is to be performed for the discus-bearing deity.
items.inference: After finishing the prescribed recitation in water, the practitioner must go and perform a great worship of the discus-bearing deity.
uncertainties: The destination implied by gatvā is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Then, having gone, one should perform a great worship of the discus-bearing deity.
